name: elian
description: Элиан / Elian — self-hosted messenger (Fastify + SQLite + React PWA)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @elian/shared && npm run build -w @elian/server && npm run build -w @elian/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
